sponsored.sum: Relates to annual reports of the boards of elections; requires such reports be made available on the boards' websites; requires that the reports include specific performance metrics.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring plaintiffs to furnish proof that notice of possible foreclosure was delivered to the defendant
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Requires plaintiffs to furnish official proof of delivery demonstrating that notice of possible foreclosure was delivered to the defendant.

sponsored.t: Relates to the correction of tax errors made by the nonprofit revitalization act
sponsored.sum: Relates to the correction of tax errors made by the nonprofit revitalization act.

sponsored.t: Requires all bus companies to post on their websites or at the places they sell tickets, certain information
sponsored.sum: Requires all bus companies to post on their internet websites or at the places they sell tickets, certain information maintained by the federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration.

sponsored.t: Relates to amending the New York City Charter in relation to expanding the investigative scope of the Civilian Complaint Review Board
sponsored.sum: Expands the investigative powers of the Civilian Complaint Review Board to include complaints alleging bias-based profiling.

sponsored.t: Relates to liability of the state for damages caused by reported defects and potholes
sponsored.sum: Relates to liability of the state for damages caused by reported defects and potholes if the report was made fourteen days or more before the damage occurred; establishes an interactive website for reporting defects and potholes on the state highway system and thruway.

sponsored.t: Requires providers of insurance policies to maintain a database of health care providers offering foreign language services
sponsored.sum: Requires providers of insurance policies to maintain a database of health care providers offering foreign language services.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the comptroller to audit local development corporations
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the comptroller to audit local development corporations.

sponsored.t: Requires written request and review of proposed reductions in the level of fire services
sponsored.sum: Requires written request, including environmental impact statement, and review by community boards, borough presidents and the council of proposed reductions in the level of fire services, including closure of firehouses or removal or relocation of fire fighting units.

sponsored.t: Establishes a study on the comparative qualities of cloud computing services and state data center operations
sponsored.sum: Requires the director of information technology services to undertake a detailed study of the comparative qualities of cloud computing services and state data center operations.

sponsored.t: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to provide safety briefings to passengers aboard Metro-North trains, and train personnel in safety procedures
sponsored.sum: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to provide safety briefings to passengers aboard Metro-North trains, and train personnel in safety procedures.

sponsored.t: Provides a tax credit for the installation of certain fire sprinkler systems
sponsored.sum: Provides a tax credit for the installation of fire sprinkler systems for residential properties.

sponsored.t: Relates to rotary and roundabout use and safety awareness
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to establish the "rotary and roundabout use and safety awareness" component for the pre-licensing class as a prerequisite for obtaining a license to operate a motor vehicle.

sponsored.t: Provides for protections regarding consumer litigation funding
sponsored.sum: Establishes that consumer litigation funding transactions should be subject to state regulation and sets forth requirements regarding disclosure, licensing, funding company and attorney responsibilities and limitations, violations and other provisions.

sponsored.t: Establishes a career and technical high school diploma for students completing a course of study for a career or trade
sponsored.sum: Establishes a career and technical high school diploma (CTE) for students completing a course of study for a career or trade.

sponsored.t: Relates to unfair claim settlement practices
sponsored.sum: Provides that an insurer doing business in this state shall be liable to a policy holder for such insurer's refusal to pay or unreasonable delay of payment to the policy holder if such refusal or delay was not substantially justified; enumerates instances whereby an insurer's refusal or delay of payment is not substantially justified including intentional negligence, failure to act in good faith, failure to provide written denial of claim, failure to make final determination of claim within six months, and failure to promptly proceed with the appraisal process.

sponsored.t: Provides a judicial remedy to resolve complaints related to utility bills
sponsored.sum: Provides a judicial remedy to resolve complaints related to utility bills that have an alleged amount of damages exceeding twenty-five thousand dollars.

sponsored.t: Relates to the conduct of public hearings by the metropolitan transportation authority
sponsored.sum: Relates to the conduct of public hearings by the metropolitan transportation authority; requires one additional hearing where more than 75 persons are unable to attend a required public hearing due to limited seating capacity.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of residence and residential real property
sponsored.sum: Relates to the definition of residence and residential real property.

sponsored.t: Enacts the New York state drinking water bill of rights
sponsored.sum: Relates to the right to safe, clean, affordable, and accessible water adequate for human consumption, cooking, and sanitary purposes.

sponsored.t: Relates to prioritizing union labor for certain transit projects of the metropolitan transportation authority
sponsored.sum: Requires the metropolitan transportation authority to prioritize and hire union labor for proposed public work before making a contract available for public bidding.

sponsored.t: Requires the New York state thruway authority to provide notice, a description of meeting details and a sign up list prior to meetings of the board
sponsored.sum: Requires the New York state thruway authority to provide notice, a description of meeting details and a sign up list prior to meetings of the board.

sponsored.t: Requires the office of parks, recreation and historic preservation to review the policies of the department of parks and recreation of the city of New York regarding trees and tree maintenance
sponsored.sum: Requires the office of parks, recreation and historic preservation to review the policies of the department of parks and recreation of the city of New York regarding trees and tree maintenance.

sponsored.t: Provides protection to cellular telephone subscribers who purchase cellular telephone applications
sponsored.sum: Provides protection to cellular telephone subscribers who purchase cellular telephone applications; allows for transfer of such applications upon an upgrade or defect in such cellular telephone.

sponsored.t: Relates to storm hardening and system resiliency plans
sponsored.sum: Requires each electric corporation to submit a storm hardening and system resiliency plan to the public service commission for review and approval; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Provides that in proceedings to review real property assessments in N.Y. city assessing method, capitalization rate, etc. must be disclosed
sponsored.sum: Provides that in judicial proceedings to review real property assessments in cities of one million or more inhabitants, the assessing method, capitalization rate, and other data or formula used to determine valuation must be disclosed to the petitioner.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring the metropolitan transportation authority to create ten-year capital program plans
sponsored.sum: Requires the metropolitan transportation authority to create ten-year capital program plans.

sponsored.t: Provides for the protection of the air quality at day care centers licensed by the state and head start day care centers funded pursuant to federal law
sponsored.sum: Provides for the protection of the air quality at licensed day care centers and head start day care centers funded pursuant to federal law; requires the office of children and family services to consult with the commissioners of environmental conservation and health regarding the air quality and environmental hazards that may be involved with any new day care center or head start day care center; requires such office to consult with the department of health if any new environmental or environmental health hazard arises.

sponsored.t: Establishes the bureau of the senior tenants' advocate in the state office for the aging
sponsored.sum: Establishes the bureau of the senior tenants' advocate within the state office for the aging; provides that the senior tenants' advocate shall assist senior citizen tenants in resolving complaints they may have with the New York state division of housing and community renewal, landlord disputes, rent increases, and other housing related matters; provides that the governor shall appoint the senior tenants' advocate.

sponsored.t: Relates to property/casualty insurance contracts
sponsored.sum: Exempts a person from being considered in an accident when such person was involved in the accident only as a pedestrian.

sponsored.t: Relates to credit card processing fees
sponsored.sum: Permits regulatory agencies to adjust any authorized fares to account for credit card processing fees for meters used in for-hire vehicles and requires credit card processing fees to be separately stated on receipts to passengers of such vehicles.

sponsored.t: Relates to the adjudication of toll collection violations
sponsored.sum: Relates to the adjudication of toll collection violations.

sponsored.t: Relates to a tax on gross income upon every corporation which derives income from the data individuals of this state share with such corporations
sponsored.sum: Requires a five percent tax on gross income upon every corporation which derives income from the data individuals of this state share with such corporations; establishes the New York data fund to distribute the earnings of the five percent to each taxpayer of the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to the creation of a land bank in N.Y. city
sponsored.sum: Creates a land bank in a city with eight million or more residents by adoption of a local law by the city council; limits board membership to eleven members.

sponsored.t: Relates to the project notification fee for asbestos removal
sponsored.sum: Exempts owners of one, two or three unit owner-occupied dwellings from the project notification fee for asbestos removal.

sponsored.t: Relates to limitations on the processing and approval of applications seeking licensure of a licensed home care services agency
sponsored.sum: Relates to limitations on the processing and approval of applications seeking licensure of a licensed home care services agency.

sponsored.t: Relates to the Long Island Rail Road weekend reduced fare program
sponsored.sum: Amends the Long Island Rail Road weekend reduced fare program to include the East New York station.

sponsored.t: Directs the New York state department of health to conduct a study on asthma in the 5th congressional district
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York state department of health to conduct a study on the high incidence of asthma in the 5th congressional district and to prepare a remedial plan.

sponsored.t: Creates city university of New York center for excellence in urban education to enhance the quality of teaching in public schools in N.Y. city
sponsored.sum: Creates the city university of New York center for excellence in urban education to enhance the quality of teaching in public schools in NYC; establishes the regents public school teacher loan forgiveness program to allocate awards annually to teachers who agree to teach public school in an area of New York state designated by the board of regents as having a shortage of public school teachers.

sponsored.t: Relates to requirements for metropolitan transportation authority hearings for proposed fare increases, major reductions of transportation and/or major service changes
sponsored.sum: Requires the MTA to hold hearings in each county affected by proposed fare increases, major reductions of transportation and/or major service changes; does not apply to standard seasonal or holiday adjustments, temporary changes due to routine maintenance and/or temporary changes in response to emergency situations; requires the authority to hold a hearing in each county of a service area that is affected by the proposed change(s) in fares or services, provided that such hearings be limited to one hearing per calendar day.

sponsored.t: Establishes a student loan borrower bill of rights
sponsored.sum: Establishes the student loan borrower bill of rights to protect borrowers and ensure that student loan servicers act more as loan counselors than debt collectors.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring a full paid work day off for registered voters on certain election days
sponsored.sum: Provides all registered voters on the day of the general election and the primary election in every even numbered year a full work day off without the loss of pay; provides a tax credit to small businesses who provide a paid day off to employees on general election day.

sponsored.t: Relates to the publication by the state of the receipt of unclaimed funds
sponsored.sum: Relates to the publication by the state of the receipt of unclaimed funds.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the inclusion of confidential clauses in contracts entered into for the purchase of services or commodities by the state
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the inclusion of confidential clauses in contracts entered into for the purchase of services or commodities by the state.

sponsored.t: Prohibits cancellation, non-renewal or conditioning renewal of automobile insurance when dispute as to pending claim exists
sponsored.sum: Prohibits cancellation, non-renewal or conditioning renewal of automobile insurance of a policyholder solely as a result of a dispute or a complaint pending against the insurer.

sponsored.t: Relates to safety recalls on used motor vehicles
sponsored.sum: Relates to safety recalls on used motor vehicles; requires dealers to provide notice to purchasers of safety recalls.

sponsored.t: Allows MTA to establish discount fares for full-time undergraduate students
sponsored.sum: Establishes a discount fare rate of no less than 25% for full-time undergraduate students attending an accredited college who utilize the New York city transit system, including railroad, subway and/or omnibus services.
sponsored.fis: Based upon the history of discount programs in the 1990s, it is antic- ipated that no loss of revenue from the discounted fares would be real- ized due to the amount of additional revenues generated from new riders in the system.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the study of the number of senior citizens in New York state who have filed for bankruptcy in the past ten years
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the study of the number of senior citizens in New York state who have filed for bankruptcy in the past ten years; provides that the director of the office for the aging shall deliver a copy of the findings of the study conducted and any legislative recommendations to the governor and the legislature.

sponsored.t: Relates to requirements for making of policy loans
sponsored.sum: Requires the terms and conditions of any individual life insurance policy loan to be in writing, be signed by the insured and the agent and contain a signed statement that the agent has explained the terms to the policyholder.

sponsored.t: Relates to the number of affidavit ballots to be supplied at polling sites
sponsored.sum: Relates to the number of affidavit ballots to be supplied at polling sites.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the establishment of a caregiver support program for grandparents and other older adult relative caregivers
sponsored.sum: Creates a caregiver support program for grandparents and other older adult relative caregivers who are providing primary care for children aged 18 and under either formally or informally to provide technical assistance, counseling and other resources.

sponsored.t: Prohibits foreign banking corporations from issuing payday loans
sponsored.sum: Prohibits foreign banking corporations from issuing payday loans; defines payday loans as any transaction in which a short-term cash advance is made to a consumer in exchange for: a consumer's personal check or share draft, in the amount of an advance plus a fee, where presentment or negotiation of such check or share draft is deferred by agreement of the parties until a designated future date; or a consumer's authorization to debit the consumer's transaction account, in the amount of the advance plus a fee, where such account will be debited on or after a designated future date.

sponsored.t: Establishes an office of the transit riders advocate to receive and resolve complaints affecting mass transit users of facilities of the metropolitan transportation authority
sponsored.sum: Establishes an office of the transit riders advocate to receive and resolve complaints affecting mass transit users of facilities of the metropolitan transportation authority.

sponsored.t: Directs telephone corporations to use information regarding federal and state assistance programs that qualify recipients for telephone Lifeline service
sponsored.sum: Directs telephone corporations to use information regarding federal and state assistance programs that qualify recipients for telephone Lifeline service in offering such service.

sponsored.t: Provides for the allocation of monies for dental health services in the medicaid managed care program, the child health insurance program and the family health plus program
sponsored.sum: Provides for the allocation of monies for dental health services in the medicaid managed care program, the child health insurance program and the family health plus program.
sponsored.fis: None. The bill does not raise costs, but reallocates existing monies more efficiently.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the chancellor of the city district to control and operate certain specialized high schools in the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the chancellor of the city district to control and operate certain specialized high schools in the city of New York; establishes a commission on middle school achievement to provide guidance, advice, and make recommendations to the chancellor of the city district on matters pertaining to education policy, performance and innovation in New York city middle schools; provides for the repeal of certain provisions upon the expiration thereof.
sponsored.fis: This bill would have no fiscal impact on New York State.

sponsored.t: Relates to demolition costs of residential property
sponsored.sum: Provides that an owner of a residential building which has been deemed unsafe because of an arson related fire shall be charged the actual cost of demolition.

sponsored.t: Extends the term for claiming unclaimed property from three to five years
sponsored.sum: Extends the term for claiming unclaimed property from three to five years.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring telephone companies to alert customers to replace telephone backup battery units and to provide one backup battery unit to each customer every three years
sponsored.sum: Requires telephone companies to disclose information to subscribers regarding the backup power solution for their voice service equipment.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating the cell phone users' bill of rights
sponsored.sum: Creates the cell phone users' bill of rights; provides that customers be given a thirty-day trial period; provides that a customer shall not be liable for calls or messages that were not made from the customer's phone; provides that a company shall be liable to the customer for violating these provisions.

sponsored.t: Establishes a task force to study quantum computing
sponsored.sum: Establishes a task force to study the creation of a quantum computing project to make recommendations on how to utilize quantum computing for the purposes of developing computers for civilian, business, trade, environmental and security purposes, such as cryptanalysis, in this state.

sponsored.t: Relates to capital program plans
sponsored.sum: Relates to capital program plans; provides that the MTA shall submit to the MTA capital program review board two capital program plans on or before January 31, 2030 and every fifth year thereafter; provides that all future capital program plans be submitted January 31 of the required years.

sponsored.t: Relates to the frequency that visitation or inspections of facilities operated or licensed by the office for people with developmental disabilities must be made each year
sponsored.sum: Increases the frequency that visitation or inspections of facilities operated or licensed by the office for people with developmental disabilities must be made each year.

sponsored.t: Relates to regulation of consumer reporting agencies
sponsored.sum: Instructs the department of financial services to regulate consumer reporting agencies by requiring licensing of credit reporting agencies, and allowing the department to examine the books and records of consumer reporting agencies.
sponsored.fis: Possible increase of revenue due to the results of licensing and fines collected for potential violations of future regulations.

sponsored.t: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to study the feasibility and impact of installing sliding access doors on subway platforms
sponsored.sum: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to study the feasibility and impact of installing sliding access doors on subway platforms.

sponsored.t: Expedites MTA capital project construction by establishing a process for utility relocation necessary for such construction
sponsored.sum: Expedites MTA capital project improvement, construction, reconstruction, or rehabilitation by establishing a process for utility relocation necessary for such project.

sponsored.t: Relates to courses of study in consumer awareness and financial education
sponsored.sum: Requires any school district in the state shall provide, to pupils in grades nine through twelve, one full unit of instruction designed to promote consumer awareness and financial education.

sponsored.t: Requires banks to send account notifications in certain circumstances
sponsored.sum: Requires banks to send account notifications in certain circumstances.

sponsored.t: Relates to absentee voting in nursing homes and senior citizen residences
sponsored.sum: Relates to absentee voting in nursing homes and senior citizen residences; requires board of inspectors to deliver and help complete applications for absentee ballots to residents of such facilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring the notification of a public utility company's or municipality's customers when the supply rate increases by at least forty percent and to notify such customers of bill assistance
sponsored.sum: Requires the notification of a public utility company's or municipality's customers when the supply rate increases by at least forty percent and to notify such customers of bill assistance programs by posting on the utility company's website.

sponsored.t: Relates to funds allocated to the independent authorities budget office
sponsored.sum: Provides that funds recovered from public authorities for the provision of governmental services and allocated to the independent authorities budget office shall only be used for direct expenses of the authorities budget office and may not be used for fringe benefits and indirect costs.

sponsored.t: Directs the public service commission to undertake a study of consumer protections adopted by electric corporations and utilities
sponsored.sum: Directs the public service commission to undertake a study of consumer protections adopted by electric corporations and utilities; includes reporting on the adequacy of the public service commission's assistance to customers facing disconnection of utility service.

sponsored.t: Relates to additional days of voting as a result of emergencies
sponsored.sum: Authorizes additional days of voting as a result of emergencies; includes state of emergency.

sponsored.t: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to identify flammable or hazardous materials near above-ground and grade level tracks
sponsored.sum: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority, in conjunction with the Long Island Rail Road and the Metro-North Commuter Railroad, to identify flammable or hazardous materials near above-ground and grade level tracks and make recommendations for removal of such materials.

sponsored.t: Relates to protecting the rights of Mitchell-Lama residents
sponsored.sum: Relates to protecting the rights of current and converted Mitchell-Lama residents.

sponsored.t: Relates to the personal information of a credit or debit card holder
sponsored.sum: Relates to the personal information of a credit or debit card holder; adds zip code, e-mail address and home, cell and work telephone numbers to the personal information protected.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the rental of safety recalled cars until they are repaired in accordance with the recall
sponsored.sum: Restricts the rental of safety recalled cars until they are repaired in accordance with the recall; requires disclosure of such recall notices to prospective vehicle renters if such recalled cars have not been repaired.

sponsored.t: Provides that the public service commission shall establish service performance standards for telephone corporations
sponsored.sum: Provides that the public service commission shall establish service performance standards for telephone corporations; provides that telephone corporations shall meet such standards; provides penalties for failure to meet such standards.

sponsored.t: Relates to combat veteran tax credit for entrepreneurs
sponsored.sum: Grants a combat veteran tax credit for entrepreneurs to provide a five hundred dollar tax credit to combat veteran entrepreneurs who create a business in New York state.
sponsored.fis: To be determined; per the bill the total amount to be provided statewide in any given taxable year shall not be more than $5 million.

sponsored.t: Tolls the four year statute of limitations look back period on rent overcharges where the owner of a housing accommodation acts in a wrongful or fraudulent manner
sponsored.sum: Tolls the four year statute of limitations look back period on rent overcharges where the owner of a housing accommodation acts in a wrongful or fraudulent manner.

sponsored.t: Requires certain employees of charitable organizations to complete a course of instruction in the law and ethics of fundraising
sponsored.sum: Requires certain employees of charitable organizations to complete a course of instruction in the law and ethics of fundraising.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the New York city council to oversee the activities of the New York city housing authority
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the New York city council to oversee the activities of the New York city housing authority.
sponsored.fis: No fiscal implications for the State.

sponsored.t: Requires a phone company to restore service promptly when phone service goes down for someone who uses a medical alert system or a device that transmits medical data
sponsored.sum: Requires a phone company to restore service promptly when phone service goes down for someone who uses a medical alert system or a device that transmits medical data.

sponsored.t: Creates the New York city transit authority safety advisory panel to study and report on safety from terrorist acts
sponsored.sum: Creates the New York city transit authority safety advisory panel to study and report on safety from terrorist acts and to provide a moratorium on the closing of token booths and minimum staffing levels on trains operated in passenger service in the NYC transit system.

sponsored.t: Requires gas corporations to file a plan addressing aging or leaking pipelines within their service territory
sponsored.sum: Requires gas corporations to file a plan with the public service commission addressing aging or leaking pipelines within their service territory; outlines plans for the replacement of such pipelines.
sponsored.fis: Likely costs related to administrative work of the Department of Public Service.

sponsored.t: Establishes restrictions on consumer and employment contracts
sponsored.sum: Establishes restrictions on consumer and employment contracts.

sponsored.t: Relates to the creation of the New York city parks construction authority
sponsored.sum: Creates the New York city parks construction authority and transfers the powers and duties relating to financing, construction, rehabilitation and maintenance of parks and recreation facilities.
sponsored.fis: Fiscal impact to the City of New York to be determined.

sponsored.t: Relates to the time election day workers must be at poll sites to prepare for the opening of polls
sponsored.sum: Relates to the time election day workers must be at poll sites to prepare for the opening of polls; one hour instead of one-half hour.

sponsored.t: Relates to exempting the metropolitan transportation authority from bond issuance charges
sponsored.sum: Exempts the metropolitan transportation authority from bond issuance charges otherwise required to be paid to the state.

sponsored.t: Requires a public hearing for substantial change in transit authority service by the New York city transit authority
sponsored.sum: Conditions the institution of any substantial change in surface route or rapid transit route service upon approval by the metropolitan transportation authority and committee on operations of the NYC transit authority and upon public hearing; sets allotted individual and aggregate speaking time during such hearings.

sponsored.t: Requires gas and electric utilities to make available to landlords upon request information concerning gas and electric charges incurred for residential premises
sponsored.sum: Requires gas and electric utilities to make available to landlords or lessors, upon request of prospective tenants or lessees, information concerning gas and electric charges incurred for residential rental premises.

sponsored.t: Exempts certain guardianship motions filed under article 81 of the mental hygiene law from the filing fee required to be paid to the county clerk
sponsored.sum: Exempts guardianship motions filed under article 81 of the mental hygiene law by a fiduciary, court evaluator, guardian ad litem, court-appointed attorney or by the court examiner from the required filing fee.

sponsored.t: Requires ATM machines to release ATM cards with EVM chips prior to disbursing cash or a receipt
sponsored.sum: Requires ATM machines to release ATM cards with EVM chips prior to disbursing cash or a receipt; defines EVM chip and related terms.

sponsored.t: Clarifies the time in which the public service commission must act upon certain petitions
sponsored.sum: Clarifies the time in which the public service commission must act upon certain petitions; requires reporting to the legislature.

sponsored.t: Establishes the new American homebuyer assistance program within the state of New York mortgage agency
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New American homebuyer assistance program within the state of New York mortgage agency to assist first time homebuyers by imposing flexible documentation guidelines that take into account foreign documentation of income and assets.

sponsored.t: Establishes additional notice requirements for site selection for community residential facilities
sponsored.sum: Provides that a sponsoring agency shall give notice to persons owning property within 500 feet of a proposed site of a community residential facility; requires hearings to include evaluation of alternative sites; gives the municipality additional time to respond; gives municipality sixty rather than forty days after such notice to approve or object to the proposed site.

sponsored.t: Relates to extending certain filing deadlines for the industrial and commercial abatement program
sponsored.sum: Relates to extending certain filing deadlines for the industrial and commercial abatement program by authorizing the department of finance to accept certain applications for an additional three months.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of mental health to issue a review and report regarding certain facilities
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of mental health to review all proposals by an agency to provide new services at a new facility, expand the size of existing facilities or change the type of services that are provided at facilities within a city of one million or more; provides a definition for the types of facilities subject to such review; directs the commissioner of mental health to issue a report regarding such review.

sponsored.t: Establishes a gang prevention coordination council
sponsored.sum: Establishes a gang prevention coordination council to evaluate the needs and strengths of local governments in each county of the state relating to juvenile delinquency, gang activity, and gang violence and prevention, award grants to local government agencies and not-for-profit corporations; publish guidelines for local governments to implement evidence-based practices to prevent gang activity and prevent youth from joining gangs; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Establishes tenants' right to offset rental payments by the cost of certain emergency repairs
sponsored.sum: Allows a tenant to offset against future rental payments the cost of certain emergency repairs a landlord is either unwilling or unable to correct within twenty-four hours of notice to the landlord of the need for such emergency repair, provided that the tenant provides landlord with itemized cost accounting of all emergency repairs made.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring hospitals to provide forms in Punjabi
sponsored.sum: Requires hospitals to provide medical forms in Punjabi.

sponsored.t: Requires certain information to be filed with the department of public service
sponsored.sum: Requires certain information to be filed with the department of public service.

sponsored.t: Relates to review and approval of all new facilities
sponsored.sum: Requires the New York city planning commission to regulate and restrict the new location or continued operation of a social services facility.

sponsored.t: Requires certain department of motor vehicle forms and applications to be available in Punjabi, Bengali and Hindi
sponsored.sum: Requires department of motor vehicle forms, tests and applications for permits and licenses in a city with a population of one million or more to be available in Punjabi, Bengali and Hindi.

sponsored.t: Relates to applications for the approval and construction of energy-related projects
sponsored.sum: Relates to applications for the approval and construction of energy-related projects of the New York Power Authority by the public authorities control board.
sponsored.fis: Review of the Power Authority's projects will protect the interests of New York taxpayers.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring local disaster preparedness plans to include a public education component as part of disaster prevention
sponsored.sum: Requires local disaster preparedness plans to include a public education component as part of disaster prevention, which shall be widely disseminated and shall take into consideration the linguistic and cultural characteristics of the inhabitants.

sponsored.t: Relates to contractual relationships with minority and women-owned businesses
sponsored.sum: Relates to contractual relationships with minority-owned and women-owned businesses.

sponsored.t: Relates to notices to voters of registration cancellation or inactive status
sponsored.sum: Ensures that boards of elections provide adequate notice to each voter before and after a board cancels the voter's registration or places such voter in inactive status.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a computerized database containing information relating to the storage and handling of hazardous substances and emergency responses to the release of hazardous substances
sponsored.sum: Establishes a computerized database containing information relating to the storage and handling of hazardous substances and emergency responses to the release of hazardous substances.

sponsored.t: Relates to awards of certain contracts to small businesses or businesses certified under article 15-A of the executive law
sponsored.sum: Relates to awards of certain contracts to small businesses or businesses certified under article 15-A of the executive law.
sponsored.fis: None. The pilot program is limited to the utilization of existing authority assets and is capped.

sponsored.t: Relates to the submission of a twenty-year capital needs assessment
sponsored.sum: Requires the submission of a twenty-year capital needs assessment to the metropolitan transportation authority capital program review board.

sponsored.t: Relates to on site superintendent or maintenance supervisor at city of NY housing authority facilities and repeals section 27-2056 of the NY city administrative code relating to exemption to the housing authority
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing an on site supervisor or maintenance supervisor at city of New York housing authority facilities, including janitorial services to maintain workable locks on doors and repeals provisions relating to exemption to the housing authority.

sponsored.t: Provides for congestion pricing for motorcycles in the central business district
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Triborough bridge and tunnel authority to impose tolls and fees for congestion pricing for motorcycles in the central business district in the amount of half of the charges for the tolls and fees of other vehicles.

sponsored.t: Enacts the statewide transportation authority reinvestment (STAR) act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the statewide transportation authority reinvestment (STAR) act; exempts mass transit authorities from bond issuance charges.
sponsored.fis: To be determined. Several sources do provide estimates of money spent on bond issuance fees, however. According to the Daily News publication in February 2012, the metropolitan transportation authority paid $106 million in bond issuance fees over the preceding six years. It also stated that the authority paid $30 million in bond issuance fees in year 2008-2009 and almost $20 million in fees in year 2010-2011. According to the state Comptroller's office, the MTA paid about $14 million in bond issuance fees in 2015-2016. The state collected a total of $91 million in fees during that year from just 14 public authorities According to the New York Times publication in November 2017, the MTA paid $328 million in bond issuance fees over the preceding 15 years. It should be noted that in 2012 and 2013, Governor Andrew M. Cuomo agreed to waive the bond issuance charge for certain types of bonds…

sponsored.t: Relates to the creation of an advisory board within the department of agriculture and markets on food safety and inspection programs
sponsored.sum: Requires the creation of a thirteen member advisory board within the department of agriculture and markets on food safety and inspection programs; establishes such board is to advise, counsel and confer with the commissioner of agriculture and markets on matters dealing with enforcement of laws and regulations regarding food safety and protection and shall make recommendations regarding any necessary statutory or regulatory changes.

sponsored.t: Relates to attendance policies for employees of the metropolitan transportation authority or contractors of Nassau and Suffolk counties providing public transportation
sponsored.sum: Relates to attendance policies for employees of the metropolitan transportation authority or contractors of Nassau and Suffolk counties providing public transportation regarding time off for medical services and court appearances.

sponsored.t: Prohibits co-location of a charter school in a public school building in a city school district in a city having a population of one million or more inhabitants; repealer
sponsored.sum: Prohibits co-location of a charter school in a public school building in a city school district in a city having a population of one million or more inhabitants.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring mandatory arbitration clauses in certain consumer contracts to be disclosed to the consumer
sponsored.sum: Requires mandatory arbitration clauses in certain consumer contracts to be disclosed and explained to the consumer.

sponsored.t: Provides family leave in the event of a stillbirth or miscarriage
sponsored.sum: Provides up to four weeks of paid family leave in the event of a stillbirth and up to one week of paid family leave in the event of a miscarriage.

sponsored.t: Provides that the MTA shall not use cleaning materials or chemicals which may cause asthma or trigger or exacerbate the symptoms of asthma
sponsored.sum: Provides that the MTA shall not use cleaning materials or chemicals which may cause asthma or trigger or exacerbate the symptoms of asthma.

sponsored.t: Requires insurer to respond within thirty days of a request from an insured for their health plan documents
sponsored.sum: Requires insurer to respond within thirty days of a written request from an insured for their health plan documents, including copies of most recent group or individual contracts.

sponsored.t: Limits the off label use of antipsychotic drugs on elderly patients with dementia
sponsored.sum: Limits the off label use of antipsychotic drugs with black box warnings on elderly patients with dementia; provides for professional misconduct for any health care professional who uses such drug on such patient.

sponsored.t: Establishes criteria for the sale of automated employment decision tools
sponsored.sum: Establishes criteria for the use of automated employment decision tools; provides for enforcement for violations of such criteria.

sponsored.t: Requires gas corporations and electric corporations in this state to file quarterly reports with the legislature regarding infrastructure upgrades
sponsored.sum: Requires gas corporations and electric corporations in this state to file quarterly reports with the legislature regarding infrastructure upgrades.

sponsored.t: Relates to consultation with affected parties on certain projects
sponsored.ls: New York State Urban Development Corporation Act
sponsored.sum: Relates to consultation with affected parties on certain projects.

sponsored.t: Provides for a 5% automobile insurance premium reduction for non-commercial passenger motor vehicles equipped with an operating dashboard camera
sponsored.sum: Provides for a 5% automobile insurance premium reduction for non-commercial passenger motor vehicles equipped with an operating dashboard camera; establishes means for certification of the installation of such camera; establishes civil penalties for false certification of such installation; provides for insurer review during claims settlement of the images from dashboard cameras; provides for the certification of the installation of operating dashboard cameras during the annual motor vehicle inspection; directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to establish standards for dashboard cameras; provides for the introduction as evidence of dashboard camera images into evidence in civil and…

sponsored.t: Relates to an annual report of department statistics
sponsored.sum: Relates to an annual report of department statistics.

sponsored.t: Establishes environmental standards for public authorities
sponsored.sum: Establishes environmental standards for public authorities; establishes targets and timetables to achieve reductions in greenhouse gas emissions, energy and water for certain buildings, facilities, vehicles and vehicle fleets owned or leased by certain public authorities.

sponsored.t: Relates to a moratorium on new licensed home care service agency approvals
sponsored.sum: Relates to a moratorium on new licensed home care service agency approvals.

sponsored.t: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority, in conjunction with the New York city transit authority, to develop certain tickets
sponsored.sum: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority, in conjunction with the New York city transit authority, to develop weekly and monthly tickets valid for optional, discounted transfers between such authorities.

sponsored.t: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to develop and implement an intra-city combination ticket
sponsored.sum: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to develop and implement a lower cost, intra-city combination ticket valid for transfers between the Long Island Rail Road and the Metro-North Commuter Railroad Company both peak and off-peak trains.

sponsored.t: Requires all public authorities owning, leasing, and controlling critical infrastructure to study the potential consequences of privatization
sponsored.sum: Requires all public authorities owning, leasing, and controlling critical infrastructure to study the potential consequences of privatization.

sponsored.t: Mandates budget expenditures by gas and electric corporations to improve power outage response and to stormproof power lines
sponsored.sum: Relates to mandating budget expenditures by gas and electric corporations to improve power outage response and to stormproof power lines.

sponsored.t: Provides for a right of health maintenance organization enrollees to continue to receive services from a provider who disaffiliates
sponsored.sum: Extends period during which health maintenance organization enrollees may continue to receive services from a health care provider who disaffiliates from 60 or 90 days to 1 year, or in case of terminal illness, until the time of such insured's death; bars incentives which induce a provider to provide health care to an enrollee in a manner inconsistent with law.

sponsored.t: Relates to residential gas service rate discount programs for low-income and senior households
sponsored.sum: Relates to residential gas service rate discount programs for low-income and senior households; establishes the residential gas service rate discount for low-income and senior households fund; provides that an eligible household shall pay no more than six percent of such eligible household's total monthly income on gas, oil, kerosene or petroleum services and gas corporations shall offer a discount to ensure such eligible household's gas, oil, kerosene or petroleum bill or payment agreement reflect such discounted price.

sponsored.t: Provides for certain tickets purchased for use on the Long Island Rail Road or the Metro-North Commuter Railroad Company to be valid at any time during the day or night
sponsored.sum: Provides that any one-way, round trip or multi-trip tickets purchased for use on the Long Island Rail Road or the Metro-North Commuter Railroad Company by a senior citizen or a person with a disability shall be valid at any time during the day or night.

sponsored.t: Provides voters an opportunity to cure deficiencies regarding affidavit ballots
sponsored.sum: Provides voters an opportunity to cure deficiencies regarding affidavit ballots in order to have their votes counted.

sponsored.t: Relates to agreements between multichannel video programming distributors and video programmers
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "television subscriber choice act" to enhance consumer choice and ensure that multichannel video programming distributors have the flexibility to offer programming packages that best meet the needs and preferences of their subscribers; requires that a video programmer shall offer each channel for license to a multichannel video programming distributor without requiring channel bundling requirements as a condition of carriage of such channel; makes it unlawful for a video programmer to demand unreasonable fees or other financial obligations for channel carriage; defines terms; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "assuring college campus and educational safety and support (ACCESS) act" relating to harassment of students and applicants at educational institutions
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "assuring college campus and educational safety and support (ACCESS) act" relating to harassment of students and applicants at educational institutions; describes the circumstances under which harassment at educational institutions is an unlawful discriminatory practice; describes the circumstances under which an educational institution is deemed to have permitted harassment; describes additional circumstances under which a college or university is deemed to have permitted harassment.

sponsored.t: Establishes a bill of rights for the unhoused
sponsored.sum: Establishes a bill of rights for the unhoused; provides that no person shall be denied certain rights because of a state of homelessness nor shall such persons be harassed, cited, fined, or arrested by law enforcement, security personnel, public employees, or private citizens for the exercise of certain rights; describes rights; provides for a bill of benefits of the unhoused for the free provision of a postal address and the right to juridical services to ensure protection from the violation of their protected rights; requires the office of temporary and disability assistance to create a pamphlet of such rights; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Creates the criminal justice infrastructure investment grant program; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Creates the criminal justice infrastructure investment grant program which provides grants to municipalities, courts, sheriffs' offices and district attorneys' offices to provide software and hardware to assist with discovery, speedy trial and bail processes.

sponsored.t: Relates to the labeling, marketing and safety requirements of vapor products; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the labeling, marketing and safety requirements of vapor products; prohibits labeling or marketing vapor products with certain terms, designs, or imagery; prohibits marketing such products to persons under 21; establishes penalties for violating such provisions; establishes the vapor products compliance fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to deductibles for physical damage insurance
sponsored.sum: Relates to deductibles for physical damage insurance.

sponsored.t: Provides for a two percent cap on rate increases imposed by utilities
sponsored.sum: Provides for a two percent cap on rate increases imposed by utilities.
sponsored.fis: None. Some savings could be realized at the state level through NYS Public Service Department.

sponsored.t: Requires a system for notifying customers of bed bug infestations on MTA subways, trains and buses, within 24 hours of discovering such infestation
sponsored.sum: Requires a system for notifying customers of bed bug infestations on MTA subways, trains and buses, within 24 hours of discovering such infestation.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring free internet service in households with students who live at or below the poverty level
sponsored.sum: Requires free internet service in households with students who live at or below the poverty level; directs broadband companies to install and/or upgrade broadband services in educational facilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to the submission of environmental impact statements by entities proposing construction of a new building development within one mile of a transit facility
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner to promulgate rules and regulations requiring entities proposing construction of a new building development within one mile of a transit facility to submit environmental impact statements; defines transit facility.

sponsored.t: Establishes a youth outreach department within the state police, city, village, town, and district police departments, and sheriff departments
sponsored.sum: Establishes a youth outreach department within the state police, city, village, town, and district police departments, and sheriff departments for the purposes of designing and carrying out youth activities organized by the department.

sponsored.t: Requires the New York city department of sanitation to remove any snow or ice accumulation in front of any fire hydrants
sponsored.sum: Amends the provision requiring owners, lessees or tenants to remove any obstructions in front of fire hydrants to require the New York city department of sanitation to remove any snow or ice accumulation in front of any such fire hydrants.

sponsored.t: Permits only one traffic infraction per traffic stop for having tinted windows on a motor vehicle
sponsored.sum: Permits only one traffic infraction per traffic stop for having tinted windows on a motor vehicle.

sponsored.t: Provides a one hundred dollar per day credit to customers of electric and gas corporations for power outages of twenty-four hours or more
sponsored.sum: Provides a one hundred dollar per day credit to customers of electric and gas corporations for power outages of twenty-four hours or more.

sponsored.t: Requires medallion owners to manage payments of the congestion surcharge
sponsored.sum: Requires medallion agents to manage payments of the congestion surcharge.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a "yellow alert system" for law enforcement to publicize vehicle information in instances of hit-and-run accidents
sponsored.sum: Establishes a "yellow alert system" for law enforcement to publicize vehicle information in instances of hit-and-run accidents in which a person has been killed.
sponsored.fis: Possible fiscal implications for police agencies and departments without existing systems and procedures for broadcasting public alerts.

sponsored.t: Modernizes the metropolitan transportation authority's small business mentoring program
sponsored.sum: Increases the threshold for office of the comptroller review of the metropolitan transportation authority discretionary awards to MWBEs and small businesses from one million dollars to one million five hundred thousand dollars.

sponsored.t: Allows certain additional privileges to incarcerated individuals when visitation is suspended for any reason
sponsored.sum: Allows certain additional privileges to incarcerated individuals when visitation is suspended for any reason.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of covered license plate frames
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of covered license plate frames; defines a covered license plate frame to mean any glass or plastic material, artificial or synthetic material or substance that conceals or obscures a license plate or that distorts a recorded or photographic image of such license plate.
sponsored.fis: Will add revenue to the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to media literacy education
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "media literacy act"; requires teachers and library media specialists to complete professional development related to media literacy education; requires a school library media specialist in each elementary, intermediate, middle, junior high and senior high school; directs the commissioner of education to appoint a media literacy advisory committee to study the teaching of media literacy; creates a media literacy advisory committee to annually review policy and procedures on media literacy.

sponsored.t: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to study and report on potentially hazardous structures and storage areas under elevated train tracks, and its commuter notification system
sponsored.sum: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to study and report on potentially hazardous structures and storage areas under elevated train tracks, and its commuter notification system.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of motor vehicles to issue New York drivers licenses to certain individuals
sponsored.sum: Relates to directing the department of motor vehicles to issue New York drivers' licenses to individuals holding a valid or recently expired driver's license from certain Caribbean countries.

sponsored.t: Requires certain companies and corporations to report certain data regarding the gender, race and ethnicity of their employees
sponsored.sum: Requires certain companies and corporations to report certain data regarding the gender, race and ethnicity of their employees.

sponsored.t: Provides for reimbursement of unused one-way, round trip, or multi-trip tickets purchased for use on the Long Island Rail Road or the Metro-North Commuter Railroad Company
sponsored.sum: Provides for the reimbursement of the ticket price of unused one-way, round trip or multi-trip tickets purchased for use on the Long Island Rail Road or the Metro-North Commuter Railroad Company if returned within one year.

sponsored.t: Establishes a housing court
sponsored.sum: Establishes a housing court for actions and proceedings involving the enforcement of state and local laws for the establishment and maintenance of housing standards; requires such court to establish an escrow account; provides that any landlord that owns twenty units or less shall be entitled to free legal services if such landlord can prove a loss of at least twenty percent of rent payments in a calendar year; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Provides an incarcerated individual time for mental health services
sponsored.sum: Provides that, to the extent practicable, any incarcerated individual who is receiving mental health services or participating in a mental health program shall not have the time spent participating in such mental health services or programs deducted from any other activity time such incarcerated individual receives.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of veterans' services to provide certain assistance to veterans
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of veterans' services to provide legal and/or technical support to veterans who want to change their discharged status to honorable because such person was dishonorably or administratively discharged from the armed services due to sexual orientation.

sponsored.t: Relates to assistance for certain small businesses
sponsored.ls: New York State Urban Development Corporation Act
sponsored.sum: Relates to assistance for certain small businesses including dry cleaners and those that practice nail specialty for necessary code related improvements.

sponsored.t: Relates to complaint procedures and retaining billing records for a certain period of time
sponsored.sum: Ensures that residential gas, electric and steam service customers will receive a written determination regarding rate related complaints explaining the reasoning for the decision; requires that decisions are made by the public service commission within 90 days of receiving the complaint; requires utility corporations to retain customer billing statements dating back at least eight years.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring agencies to provide unsuccessful bidders that are certified minority and women-owned business enterprises with a written statement articulating the reasons for rejection
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring agencies to provide unsuccessful bidders that are certified minority- and women-owned business enterprises with a written statement of the completion of the procurement selection process and that such enterprise was not selected.

sponsored.t: Relates to the New York city transit authority annual report on the reduction and abatement of noise
sponsored.sum: Requires the New York city transit authority to outline in its annual report the procedures and methodologies used for the reduction and abatement of noise.

sponsored.t: Requires food distributors that accept SNAP benefits to establish a mechanism to apply coupons to purchases made by eligible recipients of SNAP benefits
sponsored.sum: Requires food distributors that accept SNAP benefits to establish a mechanism to apply available coupons or discounts to purchases made by eligible recipients of SNAP benefits without such recipient being required to provide a physical coupon.

sponsored.t: Requires health and motor vehicle insurance policies to notify policyholders of cancellation, discontinuance or major changes to their policy via email
sponsored.sum: Requires health and motor vehicle insurance policies to notify policyholders of cancellation, discontinuance or major changes to their policy via email and to offer paperless notification upon the issuance of such policies.

sponsored.t: Creates a pilot program to encourage homeownership among persons and groups who are currently underrepresented and/or have seen a marked decline in rates of homeownership
sponsored.sum: Creates a pilot program to encourage homeownership among persons and groups who are currently underrepresented in homeownership and/or have seen a marked decline in rates of homeownership over the last decade; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Requires the commissioner of motor vehicles to create a bicycle with electric assist battery swapping pilot program in N.Y. city
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of motor vehicles to create a bicycle with electric assist battery swapping pilot program in a city with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring the chair and commissioners of the state liquor authority to file certain disclosures
sponsored.sum: Requires the chair and commissioners of the state liquor authority to file an annual statement of financial disclosure pursuant to section seventy-three-a of the public officers law.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain authorizations for fiscal intermediaries
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of health to provide authorizations to all fiscal intermediaries that timely submit a request for authorization prior to January 1, 2026; details information required for such authorizations; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Establishes a deaf and hard of hearing outreach program to facilitate communication between hearing-impaired persons and law enforcement personnel
sponsored.sum: Establishes a deaf and hard of hearing outreach program to facilitate communication between deaf and hard of hearing individuals and law enforcement personnel.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating NYCHA-based health centers
sponsored.sum: Relates to creating NYCHA-based health centers to provide basic health services for residents living on NYCHA campuses, specifically specialty care and testing for lead poisoning and mold exposure and specifically respiratory related illnesses.

sponsored.t: Relates to the submission of a twenty-year capital needs assessment to the metropolitan transportation authority capital program review board
sponsored.sum: Relates to the submission of a twenty-year capital needs assessment to the metropolitan transportation authority capital program review board; provides that such assessment shall be adopted by not less than a majority of members of the authority in the office, except in the event of a tie.

sponsored.t: Relates to temporary services provided by "health care personnel"
sponsored.sum: Amends the definition of "health care personnel" to define the term "temporary services" as health care services contracted for an initial term of less than twenty-four continuous months; requires a temporary health care services agency to annually submit to the department of health copies of all contracts between the agency and a health care entity to which it assigns or refers health care personnel.
sponsored.fis: None to the state; the bill may reduce health care entities' staffing costs by eliminating unnecessary fees and clarifying reporting proce- dures.

sponsored.t: Appropriates certain monies for capital improvements to the historic Forrest Hills Overpass
sponsored.sum: Appropriates $4,000,000 for capital improvements to the historic Forrest Hills overpass.
sponsored.fis: Four million dollars to the State of New York.

sponsored.t: Appropriates certain monies for capital improvements to the Kew Gardens, Lefferts Boulevard bridge
sponsored.sum: Appropriates $2,000,000 for capital improvements, including but not limited to structural and full remediation of the outside wall of the Kew Gardens, Lefferts Boulevard bridge.
sponsored.fis: Two million dollars to the State of New York.

sponsored.t: Establishes the "It's Your Data Act"
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "It's Your Data Act" for the purposes of providing protections and transparency in the collection, use, retention, and sharing of personal information.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a task force to study and report on the potential implementation of blockchain technology in state record keeping, information storage, and service delivery
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing a task force to study and report on the potential implementation of blockchain technology in state record keeping, information storage, and service delivery.

sponsored.t: Relates to the examination of voting machines by the state board of elections
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the state board of elections to reject the use of voting machines or systems on the grounds that such machines or systems are not proper, safe, or secure.

sponsored.t: Relates to the indemnification of directors, officers and key persons; and to repeal sections 721, 722 and 723 of the not-for-profit corporation law
sponsored.sum: Relates to the indemnification of directors, officers and key persons; ensures the survival of indemnification in case of a merger or consolidation of a corporation; provides that once a right to indemnification arises, it continues to benefit a former director, officer or key person's and their heirs and estate; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Directs the New York city transit authority and metropolitan transportation authority to ensure the proper operation of security cameras at subway stations and report thereon
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York city transit authority and metropolitan transportation authority to ensure the proper operation of security cameras at subway stations and report thereon.

sponsored.t: Relates to suspending the registration of a vehicle for evading cashless tolls
sponsored.sum: Provides that no suspension of a registration shall occur for a violation regarding cashless tolls absent clear evidence of an owner's intent to repeatedly evade paying such tolls.

sponsored.t: Prohibits discrimination based on status as a person with a prior conviction
sponsored.sum: Prohibits discrimination based on status as a person with a prior conviction.

sponsored.t: Provides for advance payment of the earned income credit by employers
sponsored.sum: Provides for advance payment of the earned income credit by employers, the commissioner of the department of taxation and finance and the commissioner of New York City's department of finance.

sponsored.t: Relates to fifth generation (5G) telecommunications towers in cities with a population of one million or more and electric vehicle charging stations
sponsored.sum: Requires anywhere fifth generation (5G) telecommunications towers in cities with a population of one million or more are installed, and there is available street parking, electric vehicle charging stations shall be provided for public use; defines terms; requires such charging stations to be designated and clearly identified.

sponsored.t: Relates to assault on certain employees assigned to an airport, while in performance of their assigned duties, or in direct relation thereto
sponsored.sum: Deems assault on certain employees assigned to an airport, while in performance of their assigned duties, or in direct relation thereto, to be assault in the second degree.

sponsored.t: Prohibits medical assistance providers from refusing to furnish care, services or supplies to any person for whom Medicaid is secondary insurance
sponsored.sum: Prohibits medical assistance providers from refusing to furnish care, services or supplies to any person who is entitled to receive such care, services or supplies under this title if such medical assistance provider furnishes the same care, services or supplies under the Medicare program pursuant to title XVIII of the federal social security act and the person is dually eligible under that program.

sponsored.t: Increases the number of licenses for tow truck operators in a city with a population of one million or more
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of transportation to increase the number of licenses for tow truck operators in a city with a population of one million or more by thirty percent by December 31, 2025.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing when a tip credit applies to employees working at tipped and non-tipped occupations on the same day
sponsored.sum: Establishes when a tip credit applies to employees working at tipped and non-tipped occupations on the same day.

sponsored.t: Establishes a two year moratorium on the third party transfer program run by the department of housing preservation and development in the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Establishes a two year moratorium on the third party transfer program run by the department of housing preservation and development in the city of New York.
sponsored.fis: There are no fiscal implications associated with the passage of this legislation.

sponsored.t: Provides for limited death benefit life insurance policies for persons aged 60 and over
sponsored.sum: Provides for limited death benefit life insurance policies for persons aged 60 and over; authorizes the attorney general to enforce provisions; requires an insurer to provide consumers with a prescribed "Financial Review of Policy" form when it delivers or issues for delivery in this state an insurance policy or a certificate of insurance for persons aged 60 and over.

sponsored.t: Relates to customers with documented need for essential electricity for medical needs
sponsored.sum: Provides that each electric corporation shall establish a unique priority phone number that shall remain in operation every day of the year for customers who have documented their need for essential electricity for medical needs; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Disaster Voting Relief Act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the Disaster Voting Relief Act; provides for temporary voting procedures in a state of emergency.

sponsored.t: Establishes protocols for the handling of stillbirths by healthcare facilities and establishing a stillbirth research database
sponsored.sum: Establishes protocols for stillbirths and a stillbirth research database.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of health to conduct a study relating to opening a new hospital in southeast Queens
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of health to conduct a study relating to opening a new hospital in southeast Queens; requires the department of health to deliver a copy of the findings of the study conducted and any legislative recommendations to the governor and the legislature.
sponsored.fis: None to the state should DOH utilize existing information.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring gas pipeline facilities to accelerate the repair, rehabilitation, and replacement of equipment or pipelines that are leaking or at a high risk of leaking
sponsored.sum: Requires gas pipeline facilities to accelerate the repair, rehabilitation, and replacement of equipment or pipelines that are leaking or at a high risk of leaking; requires the public service commission to establish a standard definition and methodology for calculating and reporting unaccounted-for gas.

sponsored.t: Relates to the recovery of costs for the response costs and damages to natural resources as a result of the illegal disposal of waste
sponsored.sum: Relates to the recovery of costs for the response costs and damages to natural resources as a result of the illegal disposal of waste; establishes that expenditures made by the department as a result of the illegal disposal of waste shall be a lien against the person who is responsible for such illegal disposal.
sponsored.fis: Provides relief to the State and municipalities by holding responsible parties accountable for costs to remediate illegal waste disposal sites.

sponsored.t: Establishes a comprehensive commercial parking plan for the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Directs the mayor's traffic representatives to work with members of the New York city council and New York city department of transportation to establish a comprehensive commercial parking plan for the city in which frequently traveled routes and abandoned or decrepit infrastructure along highways and thruways are identified in order to develop an action plan for building commercial parking in the 5 boroughs.

sponsored.t: Requires insurers which issue contracts providing long term care benefits to maintain records of policies cancelled due to increased premiums
sponsored.sum: Requires insurers which issue contracts providing long term care benefits to maintain records of policies cancelled during each year and requires that such records indicate which policies were cancelled due to, or within thirty days after, an increase in policy premiums.

sponsored.t: Expands eligibility for loans and grants pursuant to the resilient retrofits loan and grant program for private sewer repairs and upgrades
sponsored.sum: Expands eligibility for loans and grants pursuant to the resilient retrofits loan and grant program for private sewer repairs and upgrades; establishes the resilient retrofits loan and grant fund.
sponsored.fis: The state will need to allocate 20 million dollars for this fund.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crime of staging a construction site accident
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crime of staging a construction site accident which is a class E felony.

sponsored.t: Relates to the crime of staging a motor vehicle accident in the second degree
sponsored.sum: Provides that anyone who directs, hires, requests, encourages, orchestrates or invites another individual to cause a collision involving a motor vehicle shall be guilty of staging a motor vehicle accident in the second degree.

sponsored.t: Relates to electronic financial disclosures of members and candidates of the legislature and requires creation of electronic version of disclosure statement
sponsored.sum: Relates to electronic financial disclosures of members and candidates of the legislature; requires creation of electronic version of disclosure statement; directs the commission on ethics and lobbying in government shall make available an editable, electronic, readable and searchable version of the annual statement of financial disclosure by January 1, 2026.

sponsored.t: Relates to the creation of a study of the minimum coverage amounts for non-commercial auto insurance
sponsored.sum: Relates to the creation of a study of the minimum coverage amounts for non-commercial auto insurance.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring actuarial certification of certain rate determinations made by the superintendent of financial services
sponsored.sum: Requires actuarial certification of certain rate determinations made by the superintendent, in accordance with practice standards established by the actuarial standards board.

sponsored.t: Relates to the granting of continuing education credits by the superintendent of financial services
sponsored.sum: Relates to authorizing the superintendent of financial services to grant three credit hours of continuing education for a licensees' active membership in a statewide professional insurance producer association.

sponsored.t: Relates to replacement of individual life insurance policies or annuity contracts
sponsored.sum: Relates to replacement of individual life insurance policies or annuity contracts; amends provisions relating to misrepresentations and misleading statements; requires replacements regulation be consistent with policies of the national association of insurance commissioners.

sponsored.t: Relates to insurance loss prevention programs
sponsored.sum: Ensures that insurers are permitted to offer loss prevention programs as long as such programs are offered to the general public and the insurer's policyholders.

sponsored.t: Relates to the approval of policy forms
sponsored.sum: Identifies certain group policies, group contracts and certificates issued thereunder exempting them from filing and approval requirements.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of telematics systems by insurers
sponsored.sum: Provides for the use of telematics or usage-based insurance for private passenger or commercial automobile insurance or policies in certain circumstances.

sponsored.t: Provides that payment of interest payment and attorney fees to claimant when payment of a claim is overdue shall be exclusive remedy
sponsored.sum: Provides that payment of interest penalty and attorney fees to claimant when payment of a claim is overdue shall be exclusive remedy when insurer fails to make timely payment; provides such failure of insurer to make timely payment or issue denial within 30 days after proof of claim has been submitted to insurer shall not preclude such insurer from issuing a denial or asserting a defense after the 30 day period has elapsed.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of construction contracts
sponsored.sum: Removes residential dwelling units that must be affordable to residents at a specific income level from the definition of "construction contracts" for the purposes of certain provisions of the General Business Law.

sponsored.t: Relates to coverage for certain benefits under comprehensive motor vehicle insurance
sponsored.sum: Relates to coverage for certain benefits under comprehensive motor vehicle insurance; prohibits assignment of benefits to durable medical equipment providers unless approved.

sponsored.t: Authorizes absentee voting for religious observance or practice
sponsored.sum: Provides that a qualified voter may receive an absentee ballot if such voter is unable to appear personally at the polling place of the election district in which such individual is a qualified voter because of a religious observance or practice.

sponsored.t: Relates to repeated instances of harassment giving rise to a charge of aggravated harassment in the second degree and harassment in the first degree
sponsored.sum: Relates to repeated instances of harassment giving rise to a charge of aggravated harassment in the second degree and harassment in the first degree; clarifies that the victim of such separate offenses does not need to be the same individual.

sponsored.t: Restricts insurers from demanding intrusive personal, financial and tax information from insureds as a standard practice in ordinary theft claims
sponsored.sum: Restricts insurers from demanding intrusive personal, financial and tax information from insureds as a standard practice in processing ordinary theft claims where no special circumstances warranting a demand for such information exists.

sponsored.t: Relates to veterans' eligibility for public housing
