sponsored.sum: Relates to veterans' eligibility for public housing; expands eligibility requirements to include veterans of the recent conflicts; requires granting of a preference for public housing to veterans or families of veterans who have a military service connected disability.

sponsored.t: Establishes the industry targeted unemployment task force
sponsored.sum: Establishes the industry targeted unemployment task force for the purpose of concentrating unemployment assistance, job training, and job development assistance during times of high unemployment to individuals who have previously been employed by an industry that is experiencing unemployment rates higher than the statewide average.

sponsored.t: Requires notification by a prescriber or pharmacist of the substitution of one generic drug product for another generic drug product
sponsored.sum: Requires notification by a prescriber or pharmacist of the substitution of one generic drug product for another generic drug product; requires both oral and written notification.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Automobile Insurance Fraud Prevention Act of 2025"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Automobile Insurance Fraud Prevention Act"; relates to claims and medical treatment arising out of motor vehicle accidents.

sponsored.t: Relates to life, accident and health insurance; discrimination and rebating; prohibited inducements and independent sales
sponsored.sum: Relates to life, accident and health insurance; relates to discrimination and rebating; relates to prohibited inducements and independent sales.

sponsored.t: Relates to the issuance of distinctive plates for retired members of the New York state legislature
sponsored.sum: Relates to the issuance of distinctive plates for retired members of the New York state legislature.

sponsored.t: Relates to taxes on foreign fire insurance premiums
sponsored.sum: Relates to taxes on foreign fire insurance premiums; permits local governments to update outdated laws related to the disbursement of foreign fire insurance.

sponsored.t: Caps the monthly maximum payment for hotel rooms to house homeless persons
sponsored.sum: Caps the monthly maximum payment for hotel rooms to house homeless persons based upon the New York city housing authority Section 8 voucher payment standards.

sponsored.t: Establishes a tax credit for sewer lateral pipe replacement or repair
sponsored.sum: Establishes a tax credit for the replacement or repair of sewer lateral pipes by homeowners who use the home as their principal residence and have an income of less than two hundred fifty thousand dollars.

sponsored.t: Relates to notice of disclaimer of liability for certain revived claims or causes of action
sponsored.sum: Relates to notice of disclaimer of liability for certain revived causes of action; provides such notice shall occur within 120 days after the insurer has received actual notice of such revived claim or cause of action.

sponsored.t: Establishes a program to incentivize unemployed individuals to enter jobs in healthcare
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of labor, in conjunction with the commissioner of health, to develop a program which incentivizes unemployed individuals to enter jobs in healthcare.

sponsored.t: Provides for a minimum reimbursement rate for ambulatory behavioral health services
sponsored.sum: Provides for a minimum reimbursement rate for ambulatory behavioral health services.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting payments 14 days after the due date
sponsored.sum: Relates to permitting payments 14 days after the due date.

sponsored.t: Prohibits broad indemnification by a design professional of a state or local agency or political subdivision involving public work for contracts
sponsored.sum: Prohibits broad indemnification by a design professional of a state or local agency or political subdivision involving public work for contracts except to the extent that damages were caused by or the result of the negligence, recklessness, or willful misconduct of the design professional.

sponsored.t: Imposes higher civil penalties upon motor carriers who fail to report to the commissioner of motor vehicles certain disqualifying violations by bus drivers
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the commissioner of motor vehicles to impose higher civil penalties upon motor carriers who fail to report to the commissioner of motor vehicles certain disqualifying violations by bus drivers employed by such carrier.

sponsored.t: Provides a tax credit to corporations that purchase qualified green construction equipment
sponsored.sum: Provides a tax credit to corporations that purchase qualified green construction equipment equivalent to thirty percent of the total expenses incurred during the taxable year in purchasing such equipment.

sponsored.t: Directs the state athletic commission to review the need for regulation and licensing of professional wrestling
sponsored.sum: Directs the state athletic commission to review the need for regulation and licensing of professional wrestling.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a tree removal and emerald ash elimination credit
sponsored.sum: Establishes a tree removal and emerald ash elimination credit; provides that the aggregate amount of tax credits allowed in any calendar year statewide shall be ten million dollars.
sponsored.fis: Maximum of $10 million to the state.

sponsored.t: Establishes certain offenses based on homicide due to criminal sale of a controlled substance and the criminal sale of a controlled substance to a child in the first degree
sponsored.sum: Establishes certain offenses based on homicide due to criminal sale of a controlled substance; establishes the offense of criminal sale of a controlled substance to a child in the first degree; expands the definition of controlled substances with respect to certain offenses; increases the felony classification of certain controlled substance offenses; includes electronic prescriptions and blank prescription forms in the definition of certain controlled substance offenses.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing the penalties for assault on police officers, peace officers, firefighters and emergency medical technicians
sponsored.sum: Increases the penalties for assault on police officers, peace officers, firefighters and emergency medical technicians causing physical injury or serious physical injury.

sponsored.t: Establishes the zero emission industrial trucks grant program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the zero-emission industrial trucks grant program to be administered by NYSERDA, to encourage the purchase and lease of zero-emission industrial trucks, class I to III.
sponsored.fis: Annual appropriation of the Legislature or any other funds received by the state for the purposes of the program.

sponsored.t: Creates a personal income tax credit for taxpayers who pay an excess premium paid during the applicable tax year for flood insurance providing coverage on the taxpayer's primary residence
sponsored.sum: Allows an individual taxpayer to claim a credit against their income tax for excess premium paid during the applicable tax year for flood insurance providing coverage on the taxpayer's primary residence; authorizes the commissioner of taxation and finance to promulgate any necessary rules and regulations.
sponsored.fis: If enacted, this measure would reduce State revenue by up to $5 million.

sponsored.t: Increases the sale price threshold for food and drink sold in vending machines for purposes of being exempt from certain taxation
sponsored.sum: Increases the sale price threshold for food and drink sold in vending machines to be exempt from certain taxation.

sponsored.t: Requires providers to share electronic health records with plans for purposes of improving patient care and reducing administrative delays
sponsored.sum: Requires providers to share electronic health records with plans for purposes of improving patient care and reducing administrative delays.

sponsored.t: Establishes the office of organized retail theft
sponsored.sum: Establishes the office of organized retail theft within the department of law to receive and investigate complaints from any source, or upon its own initiative, of allegations involving the use and role of organized retail theft.

sponsored.t: Relates to employment of persons and veterans with disabilities by the state
sponsored.sum: Relates to employment of persons and veterans with disabilities by the state; provides up to five thousand positions may be filled by persons with a physical or mental disability and up to two thousand positions may be filled by disabled veterans and veterans with disabilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to the taxation of property owned by a cooperative corporation
sponsored.sum: Relates to the taxation of property owned by a cooperative corporation.

sponsored.t: Establishes temporary health care staffing agencies
sponsored.sum: Establishes temporary health care staffing agencies to assist qualified health care professionals to find temporary employment at health care facilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to penalties for violation of certain wage payment violations
sponsored.sum: Permits an employee to commence a private action against an employer for violation of frequency of wage payment violations; directs increased penalties.

sponsored.t: Relates to reimbursements practices of pharmacy benefit managers
sponsored.sum: Amends provisions governing reimbursement practices of pharmacy benefit managers to ensure that pharmacies are not reimbursed an amount less than the cost of procuring the drugs.

sponsored.t: Authorizes municipalities to adopt a sales tax exemption for clothing and footwear after March first, two thousand twenty-five
sponsored.sum: Authorizes municipalities to adopt a local law, ordinance or resolution providing for a sales tax exemption for clothing and footwear after March 1, 2025 and no later than August 1, 2025; provides for the repeal of such provisions on January 1, 2026.
sponsored.fis: None to the state. Individual municipalities will have to perform their own fiscal reviews when considering the clothing and footwear exemption.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting certain federal law enforcement officers and retired officers to possess firearms, rifles and shotguns in restricted and sensitive locations
sponsored.sum: Permits certain federal law enforcement officers and retired officers to possess firearms, rifles and shotguns in restricted and sensitive locations.

sponsored.t: Relates to the liability of payroll processing companies
sponsored.sum: Relates to the liability of payroll processing companies; provides that payroll processing companies that intentionally and wrongfully prevent the distribution of payroll shall be liable to employees that failed to receive an expected payment for an amount up to three times the expected amount; provides an action to recover damages may be maintained as a class action.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowing a tax exemption for fire extinguishers and fire, heat and carbon monoxide alarms purchased for residential use
sponsored.sum: Allows a tax exemption for taxpayers in the amount of the purchase price of a fire extinguisher, fire alarm, heat alarm or carbon monoxide alarm purchased for residential use during the month of October.

sponsored.t: Allows for unlicensed personnel to administer seizure rescue medication in schools
sponsored.sum: Allows for unlicensed personnel to administer certain seizure rescue medication in schools, on school grounds and at school events; provides that such medicine may be left with a school health official to be used as needed.

sponsored.t: Relates to notice of profits from a crime
sponsored.sum: Requires that an entity which pays funds which are profits from a crime, as defined by statute, to a family member, including a former spouse, of a person charged with or convicted of a crime, give notice of such payment of funds to the office of victim services.

sponsored.t: Relates to the duty of real estate brokers to supervise salespersons and associate brokers
sponsored.sum: Codifies the duty of real estate brokers to supervise salespersons and associate brokers through regular, frequent and consistent personal guidance, instruction and oversight; lists elements of supervision including the ability to familiarize salespersons with state and federal laws against discrimination.

sponsored.t: Grants Federal Bureau of Investigation police certain peace officer powers
sponsored.sum: Grants Federal Bureau of Investigation police certain peace officer powers.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring certain disclosures by attorneys performing services in connection with a real property tax grievance procedure
sponsored.sum: Requires any contract or retainer agreement between a property owner and an attorney for legal services related to the filing and appearance before a board of assessment review regarding complaints in relation to assessments shall include a written disclosure that such complaints in relation to assessments can be completed without the assistance of an attorney.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing enhanced cancer disability benefits to volunteer firefighters
sponsored.sum: Provides that the tax levy limit shall not include a tax levy necessary for expenditures resulting from a local government meeting its obligation to provide enhanced cancer disability benefits to volunteer firefighters as required under section two hundred five-cc of the general municipal law.

sponsored.t: Establishes a statewide youth mental health and social media campaign to promote public awareness of the impacts of social media usage on mental health
sponsored.sum: Establishes a statewide youth mental health and social media campaign to promote public awareness of the impacts of social media usage on mental health; requires a course of study on social media usage for all students.

sponsored.t: Relates to pretrial mental health and substance abuse evaluations and treatment for certain defendants and establishes the pretrial mental health and substance abuse services bail fund
sponsored.sum: Relates to pretrial mental health and substance abuse evaluations and treatment for certain defendants; establishes the pretrial mental health and substance abuse services bail fund.

sponsored.t: Expands the emergency medical technician re-certification demonstration program throughout the state and extends the length of such re-certification
sponsored.sum: Expands the emergency medical technician re-certification demonstration program throughout the state; extends the length of such re-certification from five years to seven years.

sponsored.t: Relates to unauthorized use of a mobile telephone or any data contained therein
sponsored.sum: Relates to unauthorized use of a smart phone or mobile device or any data contained therein.
sponsored.fis: No costs to state or local governments.

sponsored.t: Relates to tax lien foreclosure
sponsored.sum: Relates to tax lien foreclosure; establishes senior, disabled, and veteran homeowner real property tax assistance program; establishes installment plans for certain real property taxes.

sponsored.t: Relates to remote or electronic delivery of certain programs of continuing education
sponsored.sum: Provides that where mandatory continuing education programs are offered through electronic or other remote means where the licensee must provide proof of attendance by responding to a visual or auditory prompt in the program, such program shall conform to the most recent guidelines for website content accessibility guidelines.

sponsored.t: Relates to the amount of the indemnity bond or insurance required by common carrier ambulettes and paratransit vehicles
sponsored.sum: Provides for a minimum indemnity bond or insurance policy of $500,000 required by certain common carrier ambulettes and paratransit vehicles.

sponsored.t: Grants the department of financial services jurisdiction over the financing of motor vehicles
sponsored.sum: Grants the department of financial services jurisdiction over the financing of motor vehicles; requires motor vehicle dealer finance managers to be licensed by the department of financial services.

sponsored.t: Establishes the office of wastewater surveillance and creates a grant program; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes the office of wastewater surveillance; creates a grant program; provides such office shall monitor wastewater testing and analyze wastewater test results; provides the grant program shall assist labs in conducting wastewater testing; establishes an advisory council which shall provide advice on: best practices for wastewater sampling, testing and test results analysis; the creation of standards and systems of reporting on wastewater surveillance; the creation of a dashboard; integrate wastewater surveillance for COVID-19 into the office of wastewater surveillance; and any topics deemed essential by the commissioner of health.
sponsored.fis: The sum of one million five hundred thousand dollars as appropriated for the establishment of the office and the grant program.

sponsored.t: Relates to deterring theft of essential infrastructure
sponsored.sum: Provides that the theft of property of an essential service provider shall constitute grand larceny; provides a higher degree of crime where such theft results in a substantial interruption or impairment of service.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of telematics systems by automobile insurers
sponsored.sum: Requires certain disclosures by automobile insurers relating to the use of telematics systems in determining insurance rates and/or discounts.

sponsored.t: Allows certificates of marriage from foreign governments and religious institutions as acceptable documentation to change a name on a driver's license or non-driver identification card
sponsored.sum: Allows valid certificates of marriage from foreign governments and religious institutions as acceptable documentation to change a name on a driver's license, learner's permit, or identification card.

sponsored.t: Relates to declaring the goal of the state of New York to source reduce, reuse, recycle, or compost no less than eighty-five percent of the solid waste generated by the year 2035
sponsored.sum: Relates to declaring the goal of the state of New York to source reduce, reuse, recycle, or compost no less than eighty-five percent of the solid waste generated by the year 2035.

sponsored.t: Requires fire-resistant material applicators to undergo training and register with the office of fire prevention and control
sponsored.sum: Requires fire-resistant material applicators to undergo training and register with the office of fire prevention and control; imposes fines for violations.

sponsored.t: Requires law enforcement departments to report instances and occurrences of hate crimes
sponsored.sum: Requires every sheriff, county or city commissioner of correction and head of every state, county, or local police department to report instances and occurrences of hate crimes; requires the division to promulgate rules and regulations for such reporting.

sponsored.t: Establishes an integrated energy system
sponsored.sum: Establishes an integrated energy system plan that coordinates and optimizes the energy needs of combination corporation customers between electric supply, electric transmission, electric distribution, distributed energy, and demand-side resources and gas transmission and distribution to provide reliable, resilient, clean energy to combination corporation customers at the lowest reasonable cost and risk; defines terms; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain reporting requirements
sponsored.ls: New York State Urban Development Corporation Act
sponsored.sum: Relates to reporting requirements for full-time jobs where an individual is employed by a qualified participant for at least thirty-five hours a week and project hires; provides such report shall include the number of permanent full-time jobs, the number of permanent part-time jobs, the number of full-time equivalents, and the number of project hires.

sponsored.t: Prohibits city agencies in New York city from contracting with a limited liability company unless such limited liability company discloses the names of the business members
sponsored.sum: Prohibits city agencies in a city having a population of one million or more from contracting with a limited liability company unless such limited liability company discloses the names and addresses of persons having limited liability for the contractual obligations and other liabilities of the company.

sponsored.t: Establishes the Big Apple Transit Authority and the Commuter Transit Authority; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing the big apple transit authority and the commuter transportation authority for the purpose of providing such authorities with municipal control over the New York city subway system (Part A); relates to establishing the big apple transit authority within the New York city transit authority (Part B); relates to establishing the big apple transit authority; repeals provisions relating thereto (Part C); relates to establishing the big apple transit authority (Part D); relates to establishing the commuter transportation authority (Part E).

sponsored.t: Enacts the "public education racial equity and diversity act"
sponsored.sum: Relates to promoting equity and diversity in educational leadership and prioritize the issuance of new charters to community-based organizations run by individuals from historically underrepresented communities.

sponsored.t: Relates to the water board's power to fix, revise, charge and collect, and enforce payment
sponsored.sum: Relates to the water board's power to fix, revise, charge and collect and enforce the payment of fees, rates, rents and other service charges for the use of, or services furnished, rendered, or made available.

sponsored.t: Clarifies how certain non-billing information regarding the delivery of water is disclosed to residents of cooperatives, condominiums or multi-family dwellings
sponsored.sum: Clarifies how certain non-billing information regarding the delivery of water is disclosed to residents of cooperatives, condominiums or multi-family dwellings; requires water-works corporations to notify customers of their ability to receive non-billing related information.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring qualification-based criteria for awarding certain contracts for services
sponsored.sum: Requires qualification-based criteria for awarding certain contracts for services to an entity that submits a statement of qualifications in response to a request for qualifications when an authorized entity utilizes a one-step method.

sponsored.t: Relates to the amount of time between notice of a project and a public hearing
sponsored.ls: New York State Urban Development Corporation Act
sponsored.sum: Extends the amount of time between notice of a project and a public hearing.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of voice recognition features on certain products
sponsored.sum: Relates to the use of voice recognition features on certain products.

sponsored.t: Relates to installing fiber optic utility along certain highways
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of transportation to install and maintain fiber optic utility along all highways and thruways in the state for access to fiber optic and broadband services.

sponsored.t: Relates to the special powers of the Metropolitan Transportation Authority
sponsored.sum: Requires the Metropolitan Transportation Authority, in consultation with the New York city transit authority, the Long Island Rail Road and the Metro-North Commuter Railroad Company, to allow riders travelling within the limits of the city of New York to pay a fare for commuter rail service equal to that of a MetroCard ride and for such riders to make free transfers.

sponsored.t: Provides a fine for a person responsible for a trailer or semitrailer parked or left unattended in New York city
sponsored.sum: Provides a fine of one thousand dollars for a person responsible for a trailer or semitrailer parked or left unattended in a city with a population of one million or more; makes certain exceptions.
sponsored.fis: The fines charged for illegal parking would offset any cost of enforce- ment of this law.

sponsored.t: Increases the fine for tractor-trailer combinations that park on residential streets overnight
sponsored.sum: Provides for increased fines for overnight parking of tractor-trailer combinations, tractors, truck trailers and semi-trailers on residential streets in the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain housing accommodations
sponsored.sum: Provides that when a housing accommodation has been vacated after continuous tenancy or occupancy of ten years or more prior to vacancy, and the owner can demonstrate restoration of the unit, the new legal regulated rent shall be the rent agreed to by the owner and first tenant after such restoration and reserved in a lease or other rental agreement; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to the rental assistance payment standard pilot program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the rental assistance payment standard pilot program where the owner of a housing accommodation shall be entitled to charge and collect a rent equal to the maximum amount that the rental assistance program prescribes for like housing accommodations, subject to rent reasonableness calculations.
sponsored.fis: Minimal fiscal impact is anticipated, as this program relies on existing rental assistance funding streams.

sponsored.t: Relates to the implementation of a food security, empowerment and economic development program
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the department of health to implement a community food security, empowerment and economic development program (SEED) to help meet the food needs of low-income people and promote comprehensive responses to local food, farm and nutrition issues; provides grants for the cost of program projects which will be available to non-profit organizations and local governments, with limited partnership with for-profit enterprises; makes related provisions.
sponsored.fis: Subject to the availability of funding.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring financial reports for real property acquired by the state, including any agencies and authorities, through eminent domain
sponsored.sum: Requires financial reports for real property acquired by the state, including any agencies and authorities, through eminent domain.
sponsored.fis: This bill will add a minimal cost to the process of eminent domain however because it is providing needed information about financial costs and benefits it will allow decision makers to make decision that bring in additional revenues that will offset the added cost to the process.

sponsored.t: Relates to complaint handling procedures for customers of public utilities
sponsored.sum: Strengthens provisions relating to complaint handling procedures by the public service commission; requires certain response times.

sponsored.t: Modernizes the access-a-ride program's application process
sponsored.sum: Modernizes the access-a-ride program's application process by creating an online application process and notifying applicants throughout the process via email.

sponsored.t: Relates to statewide municipal reciprocal program agreements and the issuance of program bonds
sponsored.sum: Authorizes statewide municipal reciprocal program agreements and the issuance of program bonds; authorizes proceeds to be made available to a statewide municipal reciprocal program.

sponsored.t: Relates to excluding the five New York state veterans homes from certain assessments
sponsored.sum: Excludes the five state-run veterans homes from assessments on their gross receipts received from all patient care services and other operating income; directs the Commissioner of Health to apply to the secretary of the Department of Health and Human Services for any necessary waivers pursuant to federal law and regulation.

sponsored.t: Requires local community review and approval prior to the implementation of electric scooter programs and installation of electric scooter infrastructure in cities with a population of one million or more
sponsored.sum: Requires local community review and approval prior to the implementation of electric scooter programs and installation of electric scooter infrastructure in cities with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Relates to mandatory arbitration clauses in employment contracts
sponsored.sum: Requires specific notice of mandatory arbitration clauses in employment contracts.

sponsored.t: Relates to sole-source concession agreements
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of the New York city parks and recreation development to establish an application process for sole-source concession agreements; provides for enforcement of such agreements.

sponsored.t: Relates to requirements for certain contracts for materials, supplies, or services
sponsored.sum: Relates to requirements for certain contracts for materials, supplies, or services under $50,000; assures the prudent and economical use of public moneys in the best interests of the taxpayers; requires an authority in the city of New York to develop a procurement corruption prevention training program; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the manufacture, sale, and use of wire grill brushes
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the manufacture, sale, and use of wire grill brushes.

sponsored.t: Relates to eliminating daylight saving time; repealer
sponsored.sum: Eliminates daylight saving time.

sponsored.t: Relates to open data reporting by the metropolitan transportation authority
sponsored.sum: Requires the metropolitan transportation authority submit to the legislature and publish on its shared internet website an annual open data plan; requires the MTA to publish all customer surveys and complaint data, incident report data, police incident and arrest data collected by the authority or any of its affiliates and subsidiaries no later than January 1, 2026.

sponsored.t: Directs state agencies to adopt an embodied carbon decarbonization program
sponsored.sum: Directs state agencies to adopt an embodied carbon decarbonization program; requires the office of general services to continue to issue operational directives and guidance for common construction materials to reduce the amount of embodied carbon in such materials.

sponsored.t: Relates to including if a person has autism spectrum disorder on their driver's license; repealer
sponsored.sum: Includes a distinctive mark on a person's driver's license if a person has autism spectrum disorder.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the manufacture, sale, or offer for sale of a decorative or facsimile license plate that is substantially similar to a license plate issued by the department of motor vehicles
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the manufacture, sale, or offer for sale of a decorative or facsimile license plate of a size, shape, color and design which is substantially similar to a license plate issued by the department of motor vehicles, such that such decorative or facsimile license plate appears to be a license plate issued by the department of motor vehicles.

sponsored.t: Extends the time when the state is liable for damages suffered by any person from defects in state highways
sponsored.sum: Extends the time when the state is liable for damages suffered by any person from defects in state highways to between April 1 and December 1.

sponsored.t: Enacts "CJ's law" in relation to increasing the penalties for leaving the scene of an accident without reporting where such accident resulted in the death of a minor
sponsored.sum: Enacts "CJ's law" in relation to increasing the penalties for leaving the scene of an accident without reporting where such accident resulted in the death of a minor to a class C felony punishable by a fine of not less than four thousand nor more than eight thousand dollars in addition to any other penalties provided by law.

sponsored.t: Requires further source separation of certain waste in cities with a population of one million or more
sponsored.sum: Requires further source separation of certain waste which is eligible to be redeemed under the provisions of the environmental conservation law relating to beverages which are redeemable for cash in cities with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of parks, recreation and historic preservation cut down trees within two weeks of receiving notice
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of parks, recreation and historic preservation cut down trees within two weeks of receiving notice whether it was received through 311 or the department's webpage.

sponsored.t: Requires certain playgrounds to be universally accessible
sponsored.sum: Requires playgrounds in New York city parks, state parks, and municipalities to be universally accessible.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the fraudulent use of an architect's seal by a developer and provides penalties for violations
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a developer from using or displaying the seal of an architect or landscape architect on the developer's plans unless such architect or landscape architect has overseen and approved the development and creation of the plans; provides penalties for violation; and provides an enforcement mechanism.

sponsored.t: Imposes a tax on selected nicotine products
sponsored.sum: Imposes a tax on selected nicotine products, including, but not limited to a nicotine pouch or products intended to be made into a nicotine pouch by the consumer; defines a nicotine pouch as a smokeless pre-portioned pouch containing nicotine but no tobacco, which the user puts and leaves between their lip and gum while the nicotine and taste is being released; makes related provisions and technical amendments.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "department of financial services open data act"
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of financial services to comply with the provisions of Executive Order 95 of 2013, "Using Technology to Promote Transparency, Improve Government Performance and Enhance Citizen Engagement", and to provide the New York state office of information technology services and the legislature certain necessary data.

sponsored.t: Relates to owner liability for failure of operators to comply with toll collection regulations; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to owner liability for failure of operators to comply with toll collection regulations; requires public authorities to send a notice to owners upon incurring an obligation to pay a toll; provides for the adjudication of such liability and defenses to an allegation of liability; repeals certain provisions of law relating thereto.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "mandatory arbitration & business licensing act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "mandatory arbitration & business licensing act"; provides that no state agency or local government shall issue or renew a covered license to any person that refuses to certify that such person will not, as the owner or operator of a business or provider of services in the state or a local government operating pursuant to such license; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Enacts the ratepayer transparency act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "ratepayer transparency act" which requires bills utilized by public and private gas corporations, electric corporations and gas and electric corporations in levying charges for service to include separate categories for certain charges.

sponsored.t: Enacts the New York state kratom consumer protection act
sponsored.sum: Relates to enacting the New York state kratom consumer protection act; relates to labeling and other requirements for the sale of kratom products.

sponsored.t: Enacts the  civil justice protection act (CJPA)
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "civil justice protection act (CJPA)"; requires that no person shall waive a series of rights and procedures when purchasing goods and services.

sponsored.t: Establishes the office of nonprofit development within the empire state development corporation
sponsored.sum: Establishes the office of nonprofit development within the empire state development corporation to assist nonprofit organizations with business development, capacity building, technical support and education.

sponsored.t: Relates to purchase contracts of the New York city school construction authority
sponsored.sum: Increases the small purchase threshold for purchase contracts for supplies, materials or equipment involving an estimated expenditure in excess of the New York city school construction authority from ten thousand dollars to one hundred thousand dollars.

sponsored.t: Extends and expands the scope of the on-demand E-hail paratransit pilot
sponsored.sum: Extends and expands the scope of the on-demand E-hail paratransit pilot to include an additional 1,200 users.

sponsored.t: Authorizes federal fingerprint background checks for certain MTA and New York transit authority applicants for employment
sponsored.sum: Authorizes federal fingerprint background checks for certain MTA bus and Manhattan and Bronx surface transit operating authority applicants for employment.

sponsored.t: Prohibits electric corporations and gas corporations from increasing charges due to the building or operation of a data center
sponsored.sum: Prohibits electric corporations and gas corporations from passing along costs or increasing charges to ratepayers as a result of increased costs incurred due to the building or operation of a data center except to those ratepayers involved with or associated with the building or operation of such data center or semiconductor fabrication plant.

sponsored.t: Makes aggravated cruelty to animals a class E felony; repealer
sponsored.sum: Makes aggravated cruelty to animals a class E violent felony offense; defines terms; makes technical changes.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "fraudulent social media advertising prevention act"
sponsored.sum: Requires social-media platforms to prevent, detect, and remove fraudulent advertisements and to establish advertiser-vetting obligations; requires reporting to the attorney general.
sponsored.fis: Minimal direct fiscal impact to the state. Platforms bear compliance costs. Some resource needs may arise within the Office of the Attorney General to process quarterly reports, publish annual summaries, and enforce violations.

sponsored.t: Authorizes and directs the MTA to conduct a study on a unified, single city fare zone in New York City and to report the findings of such study to the governor and the legislature
sponsored.sum: Authorizes and directs the MTA to conduct a study on a unified, single city fare zone in New York City and to report the findings of such study to the governor and the legislature.
sponsored.fis: Positive. The PTA's own data shows implementation of a single fare zone for daily tickets has grown ridership at city Metro-North railroad stations by as much as 166% above pre-COVID levels. On the LIRR, city ridership growth has outpaced the systemwide average of 179% with 183% growth at Rosedale, 215% at Queens Village, and 224% at Jamaica. CityT- icket now accounts for 24% of total ridership in the LIRR's city termi- nal zone.

sponsored.t: Relates to bus lane restrictions in New York city
sponsored.sum: Provides that it shall be a defense to any prosecution for a violation of a bus lane restriction pursuant to a bus rapid transit program when an employee of the metropolitan transportation authority is performing authorized duties on behalf of such authority and is operating an authorized employer motor vehicle in the bus lane at the time of the violation and conducting lawful business or providing service to an official metropolitan transportation authority vehicle or personnel while in a bus lane.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 75 Chapter 698 MEMORANDUM filed with Senate Bill Number 6815, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the vehicle and traffic law, in relation to an affirmative defense for bus lane restrictions in New York city" APPROVED This bill would create an affirmative defense to tickets issued to Metropolitan Transportation Authority ("MTA") employees for standing, stopping, or parking in bus lanes while servicing MTA vehicles. Garnering tickets while performing authorized duties is patently unfair, however the original bill had technical errors that would not grant relief to MTA employees receiving tickets while working in bus lanes. I directed MTA to implement an administrative solution while working to address the deficiencies in the bill. The Authority swiftly did so and additionally offered technical amendments that addressed the issues in the bill. The Legislature has agreed…

sponsored.t: Enacts the "fostering affordability and integrity through reasonable (FAIR) business practices act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "fostering affordability and integrity through reasonable (FAIR) business practices act", to expand the attorney general's ability to protect New Yorkers from unfair, deceptive and abusive business practices.
sponsored.fis: It is anticipated that the increased civil penalty and widened protections proposed in the bill would result in an increase in monies remitted to the state by violators and perpetrators.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 83 Chapter 708 MEMORANDUM filed with Senate Bill Number 8416, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the general business law, in relation to enacting the "fostering affordability and integrity through reasonable (FAIR) business practices act"" APPROVED This bill would authorize the Attorney General to bring claims for business misconduct that may be unfair or abusive. I support the goals of this legislation, which would allow the state to better protect New York consumers from unfair or abusive business acts and practices, creating a marketplace in which honest businesses can compete on a level playing field. However, changes were necessary to ensure that bill does not override existing case law concerning the "consumer-oriented standard". Addi- tionally, amendments were needed to clarify that the private right of action permitted under the current law applies only to…

sponsored.t: Requires the New York state thruway authority to submit biannual reports to the legislature of all fiscal transactions, receipts and expenditures
sponsored.sum: Requires the New York state thruway authority to submit biannual reports to the legislature of all fiscal transactions, receipts and expenditures, with each report covering activity from the prior six months.

sponsored.t: Relates to access to adjoining property to make improvements or repairs
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Provides an owner or lessee access to adjoining property to make improvements or repairs for certain circumstances.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 13 Chapter 601 MEMORANDUM filed with Senate Bill Number 3799-C, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the real property actions and proceedings law, in relation to access to adjoining property to make improvements or repairs" APPROVED This bill would make numerous changes to clarify the existing legal process for a property owner to obtain a license to enter an adjoining property if they need to do so to make repairs on their own property and cannot otherwise obtain access from the adjoining owner. I support updating the current licensing procedures for the first time since their adoption in 1968, as this will help clarify important issues like permissible bases for obtaining a license and each party's rights and obligations. This bill therefore will help avoid unnecessary and time-consuming disputes. However, the bill's requirement that the license-holder obtain insur-…

sponsored.t: Relates to the organization of the Port Authority
sponsored.ls: Port Authority of New York and New Jersey
sponsored.sum: Relates to port authority organization, appearance and notice; establishes the port authority transportation advisory committee.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 86 TO THE SENATE: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Senate Bill Number 4204, entitled: "AN ACT to amend chapter 154 of the laws of 1921 relating to the port authority of New York and New Jersey, in relation to port authority organization, appearance and notice" NOT APPROVED This bill would amend the Port Authority statute without the required corresponding New Jersey legislation. Last year, I vetoed similar legislation due to significant fiscal and operational concerns. Those concerns have not been addressed. Many of this bill's provisions codify current governance and operating practices at the Port Authority. Port commissioners are already nominated by their respective Governors and confirmed by the Senates, there is a robust whistleblower process, and capital plans are made available to the public before they are adopted. I support…

sponsored.t: Relates to the debriefing of certain contracts
sponsored.sum: Provides that an unsuccessful offerer may additionally request a written explanation comparable to such debriefing to be provided by mail or electronic mail, which the state agency shall provide within sixty days of the offerer's request for a written explanation; lengthens the period in which a debriefing shall be requested by the unsuccessful offerer and the length of time in which a state agency must respond from 15 days to 30 days.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 90 TO THE SENATE: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Senate Bill Number 5149, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the state finance law, in relation to the debrief- ing of certain contracts" NOT APPROVED The bill would require that a debriefing be required to all bidders as to the reasons their bid is not accepted before the State of New York can move on awarding a contract to an individual who has submitted a Request for Proposal. This bill would add delays in the state's contracting awarding process and slow down projects. I previously vetoed a similar piece of legis- lation, noting that this legislation is duplicative and unnecessary, as under existing law, unsuccessful bidders are already allowed to request a debriefing to understand the reasons for deficiencies that result in a denial. Therefore, I am constrained to veto this bill. The bill…

sponsored.sum: Relates to certain voidable transfers affecting a federal home loan bank including injunctions and the conduct of delinquency proceedings against insurers domiciled in this state.

sponsored.t: Provides that the thruway authority shall issue permits for ambulances and fire vehicles for toll exemptions
sponsored.sum: Provides that the thruway authority shall issue permits for ambulances and fire vehicles exempting such vehicles from paying tolls on the thruway when engaged in an emergency operation.

sponsored.t: Relates to paid family leave benefits
sponsored.sum: Extends paid family leave benefits to employees who perform construction, demolition, reconstruction, excavation, rehabilitation, repairs, renovations, alterations, or improvements for multiple employers pursuant to a collective bargaining agreement who shall be eligible for family leave benefits if they were employed for at least twenty-six of the last thirty-nine weeks by any covered employer which is signatory to a collective bargaining agreement.

sponsored.t: Relates to exemptions from real property taxes for senior citizens
sponsored.sum: Authorizes localities to provide for an additional real property tax exemption for senior citizens who meet the income eligibility limits and other criteria to the extent of sixty-five percent of the assessed valuation of such real property.

sponsored.t: Ensures energy services companies are subject to the same consumer protection regulations regarding unclaimed deposits and refunds currently facing utility companies
sponsored.sum: Ensures energy services companies are subject to the same consumer protection regulations regarding unclaimed deposits and refunds currently facing utility companies.

sponsored.t: Relates to procedures relating to driving while ability impaired by drugs
sponsored.sum: Alters the definition of "drug" in the vehicle and traffic law to include any substance or combination of substances that impair, to any extent, physical or mental abilities; defines impairment and intoxication; provides that refusal to submit to a breath test and/or oral/bodily fluid test shall be a traffic infraction; makes related provisions.

sponsored.sum: Relates to notice of the posting and modification of a pamphlet on residential mortgages of which such information shall be provided to mortgage bankers and banking organizations.

sponsored.sum: Increases membership on the state fire prevention and building code council to include the commissioner of agriculture and markets; amends the effectiveness thereof.
